# clinvar-sub-bundle (a real pretty-printed ClinVar-GKM sub-bundle)

`clinvar-variation-10-bundle.json` is the records reached from ClinVar variation 10, schema 1.1.0, pretty-printed, copied
byte for byte from `ga4gh/gkm-starter-kit` (`https://github.com/ga4gh/gkm-starter-kit`):

- source path: `docs/data/bundle/clinvar-variation-10-bundle.json`
- source commit: `85a1392873f3d79d69ca227ea3f9490290aac311`
- sha256: `dbc55111cb957cc924088fae530fb51a898636c9a19934332a2807d052e65006`

It shows that layout is a property of the file, not of the pairing: the same schema and column set as the line-layout
excerpt in `tests/fixtures/real-1.1.0/`, read by the general reader, with a JSON-equal round trip. The source repository's
`LICENSE` is CC0 1.0 Universal.
